rv.q: The Chicago premiere of Julie Dunlap and Sara Stotts’ gleeful, gut-busting musical comedy makes a great girls’ afternoon or night out.

MotherFreakingHood! is a very funny romp through very familiar territory that the two Kansas City playwrights tweak with such fresh ideas—ever seen dancing pills?—that the entire two hours is a total joy.
This delightful musical comedy is only playing thru June 11th

cn.t: Critics praise this hilarious musical celebration of motherhood for its honest, irreverent humor and tuneful songs that capture the joys and challenges of child-rearing with smart, relatable wit.
